title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027

claims.claim: NVIDIA, 25 Ekim 2026'da sona eren üçüncü çeyrekte 115,8 milyar dolar gelir elde etti.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago.
Q3 revenue more than doubled from the same period last year up to total $115.8 billion, driven by data center revenue that was up 110 percent and exceeding Wall Street expectations.
Q3 revenue more than doubled from the same period last year up to total $115.8 billion

claims.claim: NVIDIA'nın üçüncü çeyrek Veri Merkezi geliri 107,6 milyar dolar olarak gerçekleşti.

evidence.quote: Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago
driven by data center revenue that was up 110 percent and exceeding Wall Street expectations.

claims.claim: NVIDIA, üçüncü çeyrekte GAAP brüt kâr marjını %74,8, GAAP seyreltilmiş hisse başına kazancını ise 2,70 dolar olarak açıkladı.

evidence.quote: For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 74.8% and 74.9%, respectively. GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.70 and $2.68, respectively.

claims.claim: NVIDIA Yönetim Kurulu, Eylül 2026'da şirketin hisse geri alım yetkisini süresiz olarak 150 milyar dolar artırmayı onayladı.

evidence.quote: In September 2026, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors approved an increase of $150 billion to the company’s share repurchase authorization, without expiration.

claims.claim: NVIDIA, hisse başına 0,25 dolar tutarındaki bir sonraki üç aylık nakit temettüsünü 23 Aralık 2026'da ödeyecek.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA will pay its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on December 23, 2026, to all shareholders of record on December 2, 2026.

claims.claim: NVIDIA, dördüncü çeyrek gelirinin artı veya eksi yüzde 3 sapma ile 130,0 milyar dolar olmasını bekliyor.

evidence.quote: Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%.

claims.claim: NVIDIA'nın üçüncü çeyrek Uç Bilişim (Edge Computing) geliri 8,2 milyar dolar oldu.
Geçici CEO ve CFO Colette Kress, NVIDIA'nın momentumunun gerçek olduğunu ve Vera Rubin'in patlayıcı bir başlangıç yaptığını belirtti.

evidence.quote: “Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start...

“Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.”
